prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget, and what “AI” means for your project (creative generation, personalization, ad optimization, attribution, predictive modeling, etc.). If you tell me more about your needs I can give a tailored recommendation. Meanwhile here’s a concise, practical approach.

Quick questions
- What’s your primary goal? (brand awareness, e‑commerce growth, lead gen for B2B, creative automation, personalization, etc.)
- Monthly or campaign budget range?
- Company size / industry?
- Timeframe and KPIs that matter most?

LA agencies to consider (have AI/data-driven capabilities or strong tech teams)
- R/GA — full‑service digital + technology + creative; good for product/brand/experience work with advanced tech integration.  
- AKQA — experience design and product engineering; strong in data-informed creative and AI-driven UX.  
- Merkle — data, CRM, personalization at scale, strong machine‑learning and enterprise integrations.  
- VaynerMedia — social-first performance and creative; rapid experimentation and data-driven ad optimization.  
- 3Q Digital — performance marketing and analytics with a heavy data‑science focus.  
- Tinuiti — e‑commerce and performance marketing; strong automation and platform optimization.  
- Persado / Phrasee — if your primary need is AI‑generated marketing language and subject‑line optimization (specialist vendors).

How to pick (vetting checklist)
- Ask for measurable case studies in your industry (revenue lift, CPA, ROAS, LTV).  
- Confirm what “AI” they use: off‑the‑shelf tools vs custom models, and how explainable those models are.  
- Check data access & privacy: can they work with your first‑party data and meet compliance needs?  
- Technical fit: do they integrate with your CDP/CRM/ads stack (e.g., SFMC, Braze, GA4, Shopify, Meta, Google Ads)?  
- Team & process: who will own modeling vs creative vs measurement? Request bios.  
- Pricing & pilots: look for a short paid pilot with clear KPIs before a long contract.  
- References: speak to two current/ex clients with similar goals.

If you want, I can:
- Recommend the top 3 agencies for your specific brief (tell me goals, budget, industry), or  
- Draft a short RFP/pilot scope you can send to agencies and a template email to request case studies and pricing.

Which would you prefer?
